query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.plan, o.id as org_id, o.name as org_name, o.plan as org_plan, o.maxBrands 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.ownerId = u.id 
WHERE u.email = 'jovitansoh@gmail.com';
